paths.description: Homepage feed, global navigation, personalization-free content, global headers, responsiveness and load behavior.
Representative long-form article template and reading journey.
News listing and topical navigation template.
Primary content-finding flow with a populated result set.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the user dark-theme preference.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots under light and prefers-color-scheme: dark are visually identical, and the page declares light color-scheme for core chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light and dark color schemes and retint surfaces, text, media chrome, and embedded search from prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Persistent overlays and advertising compete with content.
findings.evidence: Screenshots on all four paths show a fixed content-information banner; article and news first viewports also devote prominent areas to ads.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the information notice compact and genuinely dismissible, preserve the dismissal, and defer nonessential ads below primary content.

findings.summary: The 360px condition is rendered as a scaled 1024px layout.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout primitive reports clientWidth 1024 at a requested 360px viewport, and the screenshot shows tiny desktop-scale content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width without a fixed layout width and provide an intrinsic narrow layout that does not depend on page-scale shrinking.

findings.summary: Focus and target behavior is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found many controls with outline-style none and several 20px or 32px controls; Lighthouse also reports hidden focusable navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a strong :focus-visible style, remove hidden controls from tab order, and enlarge targets to at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels where practical.

findings.summary: Main content is slow and shifts during load.
findings.evidence: The trace measured LCP 4.76s and mobile layout observed CLS 0.103, both outside good thresholds.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reserve late content and ad dimensions, and defer noncritical scripts and images.

findings.summary: The initial page load is heavy and request-dense.
findings.evidence: HAR summary records 127 requests and 4,675,484 transferred bytes, including 2.65MB scripts and 1.43MB images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a route budget, remove or defer nonessential scripts, preload only critical resources, and lazy-load below-fold media.

findings.summary: Important controls and content have invalid or missing accessibility semantics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.55 and found missing image alt, unnamed links, invalid aria-details values, an untitled iframe, and list structure errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix accessible names, use valid ARIA references, add meaningful alt text, title or hide utility frames, and restore valid list semantics.

findings.summary: The page disables browser zoom on mobile.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no in the viewport meta element.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions so users can zoom; verify reflow at 200% and 400%.

findings.summary: The page logs CSP errors during ordinary loading.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured three console security errors, including blocked inline scripts and a blocked SSO beacon.
findings.suggestedFix: Align nonce-based CSP and connect-src rules with the scripts and endpoints the product actually loads, then remove blocked inline execution.

findings.summary: Article pages omit structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The article has accurate title, canonical, description and Open Graph tags, but the metadata probe found no JSON-LD Article object.
findings.suggestedFix: Add Article JSON-LD that matches the visible headline, author, image, publication date, and canonical URL.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie flags are substantially incomplete.
findings.evidence: The header primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on the observed main response. Cookie evidence found 32 cookies flagged insecure and widespread SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply a nonce-based CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy consistently, and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest SameSite setting.

findings.summary: The page starts a broad analytics and advertising footprint before interaction.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture observed 16 third-party origins; Lighthouse found 30 third-party cookies, with requests to Yandex metrics, Mail.ru and advertising endpoints.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory third parties, remove low-value tags, gate nonessential analytics on meaningful consent, shorten identifier lifetime, and batch telemetry.

findings.summary: Core feed and article content is unavailable to a no-JavaScript crawler.
findings.evidence: Discoverability reported 0% raw-to-rendered content coverage for both homepage and article, with no raw title, description, H1, or content tokens. Crawler screenshots are empty.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core feed and article content and metadata, then hydrate enhancements without replacing semantic links and text.

findings.summary: The homepage omits the document language.
findings.evidence: DOM and focus probes report an empty html lang value on the homepage, while the article correctly reports lang=ru.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit lang=ru on every Russian template and set dir where language may vary.

findings.summary: Resource use is disproportionate for an initial feed viewport.
findings.evidence: HAR records 4.68MB across 127 requests, 16 third-party origins, and 2.65MB of script before the user chooses content.
findings.suggestedFix: Enforce per-route byte and third-party budgets, remove redundant telemetry, and defer ad and media stacks until they can provide user value.

findings.summary: Content is not reliably machine-readable despite clear summarisation value.
findings.evidence: The article offers a summarise control, but non-JS discoverability is 0%, there is no Article JSON-LD, and no structured agent capability is exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Start with server-rendered semantic article data and JSON-LD, then expose bounded read or summarise capabilities through safe structured agent tools when supported.

findings.summary: The initial page has a large memory footprint.
findings.evidence: The baseline heap snapshot contains 1,178,516 nodes and 70,054,608 self-size bytes. After repeated feed traversal it reaches 1,216,232 nodes and 73,184,221 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile retained objects by constructor, virtualize long feeds, release offscreen card state and listeners, and cap caches.

taskList.title: Restore secure headers and cookie policy
Restore zoom, focus, names and valid semantics

Cut initial script, media and third-party cost
